summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official: Ten-Minute Beginner Tutorial - Pleated Trousers ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will guide you through the process of creating pleated trousers using Marvelous Designer. Follow these steps to learn how to utilize the tools and features effectively. ## Setting Up the Scene 1. **Download the Basic Pants Version** Please download the basic pants version from the library and add the virtual model to the scene from the `femalev2` file editor. 2. **Creating Internal Lines** Select the internal multidirectional line tool and create an internal line on the pants. After selecting the internal line, you can copy and paste it. When pasting, press the mouse button and right-click to set the number of lines that are adjacent to the internal line in the spring. ## Aligning Internal Lines 3. **Selecting and Aligning Lines** Select all the internal lines on the middle panel and choose the line to be aligned with the panel line from the right-click menu. Quickly click all the internal lines on the middle panel four times. 4. **Cutting the Panel Line** Cut the panel line prepared for folding and click on the panel line. Press the Shift key to move the panel in the horizontal direction. Select the panel after cutting. 5. **Pasting the Panels** Use `Ctrl-C` and `Ctrl-V` to paste the panel. Note that the pasted panels are not linked, so you will need to select the corresponding panels and apply the parallel panel and sewing line for them. ## Applying the Parallel Panel 6. **Selecting Panel Lines** In the right-click menu, select the parallel panel. After piecing all the references onto the panel line, use the `Mycket` tool to paste the planer. 7. **Attaching the Plate** Attach the plate to the 3D window. Stick the PE panel to the 3D window using a tool named `Ladder Setting`. After peaking the panel out 720 cm by English, you can try or distress. ## Adding Fold-Down Elements 8. **Adding Inner Lines** Add the inner line to the part of the fold-down straight line point. In the toolbar, select the fold-down option. Click on the left side of the inner line and move the mouse through all the inner lines, then double-click. 9. **Folding the Inner Line** In the spring, you can fold the inner line to the fold-down angle. The effect of the fold-down angle will be more obvious after hardening. When you fold the inner line and press it, the inner line will hit the center of the fold-down. 10. **Using the Free Sewing Tool** Use the free sewing tool to fold the inner line. When sewing, ensure that the straight line point is placed at the center. Sew both sides and make sure that the direction of the sewing line is consistent with the 3D window. ## Adjusting Size and Waistband Creation 11. **Widening the Pants** Because the size of the pants is too small, the pleats are stretched. You can widen the pants by moving the outer line of the side seam and the hem of the pattern. Use the edit curve point tool to move the curve point for a smoother fit. 12. **Creating the Waistband** Next, we will create the waistband. Select the rectangle tool and press the button in the 2D window to enter the size of the pattern in the pop-up window. Use `Ctrl-D` to align the pattern with the sewing line. Show the arrangement point and click to arrange the waistband pattern around the virtual model. 13. **Curving the Waistband** In the property editor, change the arrangement position. The waistband needs to be curved to better fit the curve of the virtual model. Use the edit curve point tool to add a curve point for a smoother finish. ## Final Adjustments 14. **Ensuring Waistband Quality** Make sure the waistband pattern is square; otherwise, there will be a corner in the sewing part. Freeze the waistband and fix the pattern in the 3D window. 15. **Sewing the Waistband** Use the free sewing tool to sew the pattern together, but please skip the parts that have already been sewn. Delete any excess straight lines. 16. **Adjusting the Pattern** You can move the pattern to adjust the width of the pants and adjust the length along the waist. Correct any misalignments to suit your style. You can create two curves leaning on top of each other. 17. **Finalizing the Design** Use `Ctrl-D` to create a symmetrical belt. You can select free sewing in the toolbar in the 3D window. The sewing tools selected in the 3D window can also be used in the 2D window. 18. **Detailing the Sewing Line** Use the editing sewing line tool to move the sewing line. Reduce the particle diameter and increase the grid surface number to get more details. 19. **Adjusting for Bulges** If there is a bulge where the belt and pants are sewn, use the adjustment straight line to shorten the bulge in the plate. 20. **Applying Fabric Texture** In the material folder in the toolbar, select the cotton setting to apply it to the current fabric. Remove the inner line and simulate the cut; this will make the cut appear more natural. ## Conclusion Thank you for following along with this tutorial on creating pleated trousers in Marvelous Designer. With practice, you'll be able to refine your skills and create stunning garments. ```
